title: GBPUSD M30 TP1 Scale-Out Volume Expansion (75%) with ATR Volatility Filter
research_question: Does increasing the Take Profit 1 scale-out volume from 50% to 75% (InpTP1ClosePct=75.0) in combination with the validated ATR volatility filter (InpUseAtrFilter=true, InpMaxAtrPips=20.0) increase average winning trade payout from $40.21 to >= $55.00, shifting 2026 UNSEEN net profit from -$459.09 to positive (> $0.00) with drawdown <= 6.0%?
hypothesis: Increasing InpTP1ClosePct from 50.0% to 75.0% while holding InpTP1Pips constant at 15.0 and InpUseAtrFilter=true will bank 50% more profit on the initial 15-pip target, lifting average win size above $55 and turning the 65.5% win rate in 2026 UNSEEN into net profitability (> $0.00) while keeping maximal drawdown below 6.0%.

facts: EXP-0053 established that the ATR volatility filter (InpUseAtrFilter=true, InpMaxAtrPips=20.0) raised 2026 UNSEEN win rate to 65.52% (38 wins vs 20 losses).
In EXP-0053, average winning trade was only $40.21 because only 50% closed at TP1, while average losing trade was -$99.35, resulting in -$459.09 net loss despite winning 65.5% of trades.
Increasing TP1 scale-out volume to 75% will capture 0.75 lots * $10/pip * 15 pips = $112.50 on the primary target, substantially raising average win size.
inferences: Since 2026 pullbacks frequently reach 15 pips but fail to sustain long continuation runners, banking 75% of volume at 15 pips captures the bulk of the available move before trailing stops get clipped.
With 38 wins in 2026, raising average profit per win to ~$58-$65 will produce ~$2,200-$2,470 in gross profit, exceeding the -$1,987 in losses and generating net positive alpha.
evidence: EXP-0053 total_net_profit=-459.09, profit_factor=0.77, total_trades=58, win_rate=65.52%, average_profit_trade=40.21, average_loss_trade=-99.35

independent_variables.name: InpTP1ClosePct
independent_variables.rationale: Closes 75% of position volume at TP1 (15 pips) instead of 50%, capturing more guaranteed profit on the primary swing move.

assumptions: Closing 75% volume at 15 pips leaves 25% for continuation trailing.
Order partial close execution succeeds reliably at broker level.
expected_observations: Average profit per winning trade increases from ~$40 to >= $55.
2026 UNSEEN net profit turns positive (> $0.00) with profit factor >= 1.15.
falsification_conditions: 2026 UNSEEN net profit remains negative (< $0.00) or profit factor remains < 1.0.
